title: Yumeochi: Dreaming of Falling For You
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: University student Chono is stuck on regrets from his high-school years until he finds a mysterious book that lets him relive high school in his dreams. There he and several former classmates, now adults, get a chance to redo their wasted youth. It is a four-volume harem romantic comedy with fan service that MangaUpdates lists as cut short.
life_message: Regret need not define you; facing the past honestly can free you to live and love now.
